sweep.en: Streets, cities, rivers, and even clothing were swept up in this new cultural vision.
sweep.zh: 街道、城市、河流甚至服装都被卷入了这股新的文化愿景中。

sweep.en: Storm surge, that's that body of water that gets swept inland and produces widespread flooding.
sweep.zh: 风暴潮，就是那股被卷入内陆并造成大范围洪灾的水体。

sweep.en: Their armies swept through eastern Zaire with lightning speed, facing little resistance.
sweep.zh: 他们的军队以闪电般的速度横扫扎伊尔东部，几乎没有遇到什么抵抗。

sweep.en: If something sweeps in, it moves in very fast and very powerfully.
sweep.zh: 如果某物“sweeps in”（席卷而入），它会以极快且极强劲的方式移动。

sweep.en: This was not a wildfire that swept through.
sweep.zh: 这并不是一场掠过森林的野火。

sweat.en: They sweated, trembled, and begged the experimenter to let them stop.
sweat.zh: 他们汗流浃背，浑身颤抖，恳求主试者让他们停下来。

sweat.en: Does it mean: a) sweat, b) hot water, or c) bathhouse?
sweat.zh: 它的意思是：a) 汗水，b) 热水，还是 c) 澡堂？

sweat.en: It's hot enough to make anyone sweat, but are saunas good for your health as well?
sweat.zh: 这个温度足以让任何人流汗，但桑拿对你的健康也有好处吗？

sweat.en: I started to sweat, and I forgot everything that was happening.
sweat.zh: 我开始冒汗，脑子里发生的一切全都忘光了。

sweat.en: He would have been on time for the meeting, but it was such a hot day and he was drenched in sweat.
sweat.zh: 他本来是可以按时开会的，但天气实在太热，他大汗淋漓。

swing.en: Children run barefoot. They swing on ropes and throw themselves down a makeshift water slide.
swing.zh: 孩子们赤脚奔跑。他们在绳索上荡秋千，把自己扔下一个临时的水滑梯。

swing.en: They spend hours on the driving range, working on their swing, adjusting their stance, and improving their technique.
swing.zh: 他们在练习场上花费数小时，打磨挥杆，调整姿势，提升技术。

swing.en: In contrast to pre-made playgrounds, where swings and slides are fixed in place, adventure playgrounds provide pieces of building materials for kids to build things themselves.
swing.zh: 与那些秋千和滑梯固定在原地的预制游乐场相比，冒险游乐场为孩子们提供建筑材料，让他们自己搭建东西。

swing.en: So, when von Stauffenberg touched down in Berlin and made his way to the army headquarters, he was expecting to hear that Operation Valkyrie was in full swing: Hitler was dead, the reserve army units had taken control of the key state institutions, and the groups most loyal to Hitler, in particular the SS, had been neutralised.
swing.zh: 因此，当冯·施陶芬贝格在柏林降落并前往陆军总部时，他本期待听到“瓦尔基里行动”正在全速进行：希特勒已死，后备军部队已经接管了国家核心机构，而最忠于希特勒的群体（特别是党卫军）已经被消灭。

swallow.en: She was tough, fiercely loyal, deeply religious in her own way, and utterly determined that her grandson would not be swallowed up by the circumstances around him.
swallow.zh: 她性格刚强，极其忠诚，以她自己独特的方式笃信宗教，并且坚决不让自己的孙子被周围的环境吞没。

swallow.en: You need to shape the words clearly while forcing air through the reed, switching between Punch’s voice and your normal voice, all while making sure you don’t accidentally swallow the thing.
swallow.zh: 你需要在通过簧片强行吹气的同时清晰地吐字，在 Punch 的声音和你的正常声音之间切换，同时还得确保自己不会不小心把它吞下去。

swallow.en: The first bite of crunch is the most essential bite because, really, when we put something in our mouth, we don't think about it this way, but we have to decide whether we're going to swallow, right?
swallow.zh: 第一口咬下去的嘎吱声是最关键的一口，因为实际上，当我们把东西放进嘴里时，我们不会这样想，但我们必须决定是否要吞咽，对吧？

swallow.en: This was an era of nationalist movements, and, perfectly reasonably you might argue, these groups wanted a country to call their own, they didn’t want to just be subsumed, swallowed up, by an empire to which they didn’t feel a strong sense of allegiance.
swallow.zh: 这是一个民族主义运动的时代，而且你完全可以合情合理地认为，这些群体想要一个属于他们自己的国家，他们不想被一个他们没有强烈效忠感的帝国所吞并。

sway.en: Zoochosis is a term to describe the repeated, purposeless behaviour performed by captive animals in response to the stress of being confined, including pacing, head-bobbing and swaying.
sway.zh: 动物园精神病（Zoochosis）是一个术语，用来描述圈养动物为了应对被关押的压力而表现出的重复、无目的的行为，包括踱步、点头和摇晃。

switch.en: Even though you are still speaking English, you’ve switched between formal and informal styles.
switch.zh: 尽管你仍然在说英语，但你已经在正式和非正式风格之间进行了切换。

switch.en: Let’s end this episode with some advice on how to manage code switching effectively.
switch.zh: 让我们以一些关于如何有效管理语码转换的建议来结束本期节目。

switch.en: Cancer cells switch off the immune system by pretending to be healthy cells.
switch.zh: 癌细胞通过伪装成健康细胞来关闭免疫系统。

switch.en: And so, in 1928, he ordered the complete switch to the Latin alphabet.
switch.zh: 因此，在1928年，他下令全面转向拉丁字母。

switch.en: England and its colonies didn’t make the switch until 1752.
switch.zh: 英国及其殖民地直到 1752 年才做出改变。

swift.en: Actually, Taylor Swift's Edinburgh show wasn't the first music concert to trigger seismic waves.
swift.zh: 事实上，Taylor Swift的爱丁堡演出并不是第一场引发地震波的音乐会。

swift.en: Well, yes but actually no, Georgie. I mean, Taylor Swift literally rocks the world!
swift.zh: 嗯，是的，但其实也不是，Georgie。我的意思是，Taylor Swift真的让世界摇滚了！

swift.en: Putin’s response was swift and brutal. He promised to hunt down the perpetrators, famously declaring, “We will pursue terrorists everywhere.
swift.zh: 普京的反应迅速而残酷。他承诺将追捕肇事者，并说出了那句名言：“我们将到处追捕恐怖分子。

swift.en: The operation is almost comically swift.
swift.zh: 这次行动迅速得近乎荒诞。

sword.en: Their weapon of choice was a curved sword with devastating cutting power.
sword.zh: 他们首选的武器是一种具有极强切割力的弯刀。

sword.en: Secretly, she gave him a ball of thread and a sword.
sword.zh: 她秘密地给了他一团线和一把剑。

sword.en: But this victory was a double-edged sword.
sword.zh: 但这场胜利是一把双刃剑。

sword.en: His involvement was a double-edged sword.
sword.zh: 他的参与是一把双刃剑。

sword.en: Theseus used the sword to fight and kill the Minotaur, and he used the thread to find his way back out of the labyrinth.
sword.zh: 忒修斯用剑与米诺陶洛斯战斗并杀死了它，他又用线找到了走出迷宫的路。

swear.en: Canadian passports mention the King. New members of Parliament swear an oath to the King.
swear.zh: 加拿大的护照上提到了国王。新当选的议员们也要向国王宣誓效忠。

swear.en: Just days later, he traveled to Westminster, where he was officially sworn in as the MP for Makerfield.
swear.zh: 几天后，他前往威斯敏斯特，在那里正式宣誓就任马克菲尔德的议员。

swear.en: And before they left, so the legend goes, he made Hannibal swear that he would never be Rome’s friend.
swear.zh: 传闻说，在他们出发前，他让Hannibal发誓永远不做罗马的朋友。

swear.en: Men and women in strange masks, unusual passwords or codes, promises of brotherhood, and, of course, sworn oaths of secrecy, which only serve to add to the allure.
swear.zh: 戴着奇怪面具的男女、不寻常的密码或暗号、兄弟会的承诺，当然还有宣誓保密，这些都只会增添其诱惑力。

swear.en: With Sadat dead, blown up by grenades, his vice-president, the then 53-year-old Hosni Mubarak, was sworn in eight days later, becoming president of the Middle East’s most populous country.
swear.zh: 随着 Sadat 被手榴弹炸死，八天后，他的副总统、时年 53 岁的 Hosni Mubarak 宣誓就职，成为了这个中东人口最多国家的总统。

swamp.en: This was, in many ways, a continuation of his earlier pledge to “drain the swamp”, but now it seemed less politically-motivated, more about using taxpayer money more efficiently and for American interests rather than targeting career politicians.
swamp.zh: 从许多方面来看，这是他早期“清淤泥”承诺的延续，但现在它看起来更少一些政治动机，更多的是关于如何更高效地利用纳税人的钱服务于美国利益，而不是针对职业政客。
